newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady, but end-user demand thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady, but end-user demand thin.

text.p: NWE naphtha cash prices held steady on Friday with some support coming from trader buying interest, but the recent price gains and wider crack spread were keeping end-user demand to a minimum, traders said.
Physical cargoes were roughly unchanged near $230 cif.
Swaps extended Thursday losses which saw them touch their lowest level since mid-September in heavy trade.
Feb added a further $3 to Thursday's $4.50 fall to stand around $220/$221 a tonne and March also fell a further $3 to $211/$213. April swaps were off $3-$5 at $203/$206.
